Snow Information

FEB 9
Firmer conditions on the early shift groom yesterday, and likely for similar again today. The late shift lower mountain will likely be preferable this morning - Discovery Zone, Toby, Outrider, Horseshoe and Showoff. Late shift also did Rollercoaster, and the Sun Bowl runs mid mountain. A groomed Stumbock's rated very well yesterday morning, and should still be decent today.

Taynton continues to ski well overall, with decent packed snow base, some soft packed bumps and softer turns in places. Best conditions are on the more northerly aspects. The grooming crew looped up Landing Strip last night, putting some smoothing up into the base of Funnel and the natural halfpipe in the far drainage.
Groomed Taynton Trail running nicely overall.

Nordic groom has a good packed base for great conditions overall, likely to maintain well with the current mid range forecast. Multi-use trails have done it tough in recent freeze/thaw cycles and are not recommended for fat biking at this time. Foot traffic is recommended to use snowshoes or crampons. Check the website or in person for more information and to purchase passes.

Weather Information

FEB 9
High light cloud around today, breaking up the blue sky. We'll likely see sun shining through and some sunny breaks at times. Light SW winds at summit, calm on the lower mountain. The cooling trend has more seasonally normal temperatures with 6AM marks of -8C in the village and -10C at summit, with minus single figure highs.
